# MUS-W-0005

<!-- Generated by `mustur export`. Do not hand-edit: `mustur verify` fails on drift, and the store is the record. -->

**One repository-scoped tool call that returns records and routing**

work-unit · 2026-08-19

Discharges: [MUS-M-0002](../milestones.md#mus-m-0002)

Decided by: [MUS-D-0002](../decisions.md#mus-d-0002), [MUS-D-0027](../decisions.md#mus-d-0027)

## Context

The call the mandate names. It is a superset of the stub the disproof measured, so the clause that was measured is the clause that ships.

## Depends on

MUS-W-0002, MUS-W-0003.

## Discharges

Part of MUS-M-0002: one repository-scoped tool call returns the records and the routing.

## Done means

A call with no identifier returns the repository's routing and an index of every record, grouped by kind.
A call naming an identifier returns that record in full, and an identifier the store does not hold returns a message saying so rather than an empty result.
The tool's name and its two original arguments are the ones the disproof measured, so the mandate clause is unchanged from the fixture that was scored.
The server binds to the loopback interface only.
The returned text is produced by the same renderer the export uses, so a record reads the same in a session as it does in the tree.

## Risks

The server is unauthenticated. That is sound only while it is bound to loopback on a single-tenant machine, and it stops being sound the moment the ingress rule at MUS-M-0006 exists. Nothing in this unit enforces the ordering.
A session whose server never loaded sees no tool at all rather than a failure, which the disproof already had to design around. The mandate says what to do in that case; nothing can make the absent tool report itself.
